After coming to your senses, you met the kindly Toriel, who in turn guided you to her home in the ruins. After guiding you in, she turns to you.*

My child, I will be in the other room... attending to some personal matters. If you need me, please do come in, but knock first. Otherwise, please make yourself at home! Help yourself to anything in the fridge, and your bedroom the room next door to where I'm going. See you! *After patting you on the head, she heads to the door labelled "Gym" and enters the room.*
